subject.title: Feature request: Read pinned Telegram messages via bot API

question: Should OpenClaw expose Telegram pinned-message reads, and should the first supported shape be an explicit on-demand action/command rather than automatic session-start context injection?
rationale: The implementation path is clear enough to locate, but the durable choice controls access to persistent Telegram chat content, default security posture, and whether agent sessions silently receive pinned context.

options.title: On-demand gated read first
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned list-pins/read-pinned action or native command that fetches getChat.pinned_message only when explicitly invoked and controlled by a clear gate.

options.title: Fold into broader Telegram read design
options.body: Track pinned messages under the broader Telegram read/history issue so one retained-message and authorization contract covers both surfaces.

options.title: Defer automatic context
options.body: Do not add session-start pinned context until maintainers approve storage, retention, and opt-in UX for automatic injection.

recommendation.title: On-demand gated read first
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned list-pins/read-pinned action or native command that fetches getChat.pinned_message only when explicitly invoked and controlled by a clear gate.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest visible routing signal for the product/security decision from prior review context and adjacent Telegram history.
